review_text: Since last few updates, its quite harder to reset the password. Have tried used both app and the browser, but it fails to give the OTP code, and block user for trying to reset if user fails. You might wonder, "how users fails". Well, OTP is received after when user send the message using Message application. This redirection to Message application won't go back to its original position where eSewa app was asking for OTP pin. To use the OTP, user need to be in "that session" where it asked pin..
